versions.name: Snow Sports
versions.description: Ski, snowboard or snowshoe under control on real terrain, wax and tune your own gear, read trail markings and avalanche warnings, and treat the frostbite, hypothermia and falls that come with cold-weather sport.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
